sections.advice: Baie de Châtillon → Littoral de Tresserve is 16 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Littoral de Tresserve → Lac d’Aiguebelette is 21 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Lac d’Aiguebelette → back through Littoral de Tresserve is 21 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
back through Littoral de Tresserve → Baie de Châtillon is 16 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-baie-de-chatillon-lac-d-aiguebele.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Littoral de Tresserve → Lac d’Aiguebelette
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 23 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-baie-de-chatillon-lac-d-aiguebele.story: A 81 km round trip from Châtillon - roughly 1 h 24 in the saddle. It goes by way of Littoral de Tresserve, Lac d’Aiguebelette and back through Littoral de Tresserve. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
